definitions.explanation: How well something or someone is functioning.
The musical pitch or the manner/style of speaking.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{調子|ちょうし}がいい。
{体|からだ}の{調子|ちょうし}はどうですか。
{最近|さいきん}パソコンの{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: My computer hasn't been working well lately.

examples.japanese: ギターの{調子|ちょうし}を{合|あ}わせる。
{怒|おこ}った{調子|ちょうし}で{話|はな}した。
examples.english: He spoke in an angry tone.

examples.japanese: {声|こえ}の{調子|ちょうし}から、{何|なに}か{嫌|いや}なことがあったのだろう。
examples.english: Judging from the tone of her voice, something unpleasant must have happened.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{調子|ちょうし}がいい (in good condition/form, feeling good)
・{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}い (in bad condition, feeling unwell)
・{調子|ちょうし}に{乗|の}る (to get carried away, to get cocky)
・{調子|ちょうし}を{合|あ}わせる (to tune [instrument]; to go along with someone)
・その{調子|ちょうし}で (keep it up, in that manner)

USAGE NOTE:
{調子|ちょうし}に{乗|の}る has a negative connotation, suggesting someone is becoming overconfident or getting ahead of themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{体|からだ}の{調子|ちょうし} (physical condition)
・{機械|きかい}の{調子|ちょうし} (machine's condition)
・{声|こえ}の{調子|ちょうし} (tone of voice)
